product.description: Replacement touch screen assembly for the Lenovo Flex 5-14. Fits models with a 14" touch panel. Send us your exact laptop model on WhatsApp to confirm resolution and connector before ordering.

faqs.question: How do I know this screen fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Lenovo Flex 5-14. If you're unsure of your exact model or want us to confirm the connector before you order, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Do you install the screen, or is it self-fit?
faqs.answer: We can install it for you in Nairobi, or ship it with fitting instructions if you're upcountry or prefer your own technician.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
